title: cosmos parviflorus
intro: Cosmos parviflorus, commonly known as the smallflower cosmos, is a flowering plant species native to North America. The smallflower cosmos has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. The bioactive constituents of Cosmos parviflorus have been found to possess anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential candidate for the development of new medicines.
